issues.description: Method signature inconsistency for Lecture.addGuestStudents: the problem statement and UML require addGuestStudents(int, String) (adds guest students with a reason), but the reference solution implements addGuestStudents(int) with only one parameter. Students following the specification will implement a two-parameter method that does not match the reference solution/tests aligned to it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the spec by changing the method to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason)` (the reason can be stored, printed, or ignored), or alternatively update the problem statement/UML to require only `addGuestStudents(int)`.
